records: CoinDesk's confirmed PoR wallet is Binance14, an Ethereum address (0x28C6…1d60). It is not the five XRPL source addresses. The report's approximately 94% ETH coverage estimate must not be applied to XRP.

The official Binance PoR portal displays a Download All Address control, but static web extraction did not expose the downloadable file URL or contents. The five XRPL addresses therefore cannot yet be matched to the October 1 PoR set.

Historical Binance-labelled XRP rotations and Bithomp activation labels support a common operational-wallet cluster but do not prove inclusion in the PoR set, customer-liability backing, or ownership of every balance at the snapshot time.

The approximately 94% post-theft ETH coverage is CoinDesk's estimate using October 1 data and assuming no replenishment; it is not a Binance-confirmed current ratio. The November 1 snapshot is still pending.
